description: Absolute methane uptake isotherm points and pressure-swing working capacity of one rigid library framework with native RASPA3 GCMC. You choose the structure, a framework force field from the catalog, temperature, pressure points, the loading and unloading pressures, number of replicate seeds, cycle counts and per-job time limit. Each pressure x seed pair is one single-CPU job. Returns mmol/g of dry framework per pressure with seed statistics, working capacity, evidence and cost. The force field must type every element of the structure. Run zeopp_pore_geometry first: inaccessible pockets are not blocked here. Completion does not establish sampling convergence; compare seeds and cycle counts.

force_field_id.description: Framework/methane Lennard-Jones force field from the catalog.

pressures_bar.description: Distinct pressure points in bar (at least two); they must include the loading and unloading pressures.

unloading_pressure_bar.description: Desorption pressure for working capacity; lower than loading.

production_cycles.description: Averaging cycles per job; at least ten per block.

timeout_seconds_per_job.description: Wall-time limit of each job; pressures x seeds x this value is reserved from the compute budget.
